unlisted_practices: Clinician expert validation of symptom repository, logic flow, and AI-generated diagnoses before deployment

screen.reason: The study prospective evaluates the real-world deployment of a knowledge-based/AI CDSS symptom checker and triage tool in India's national telemedicine platform (eSanjeevani), but it does not compare outcomes with and without a specific guardrail or deployment practice.
